title: Claude Code improves efficiency with Opus model use, chat #ClaudeCode #AIcoding #tokenlimits
description:
Claude Code improved coding efficiency by using the /model Opus plan and switching between Opus 4.6 for planning and Sonnet 4.6 for coding tasks, reducing excessive token consumption. Using the /compact command compresses long conversations into summaries, minimizing repeated context processing. Adding "ultra think" to prompts encourages deeper problem analysis before code generation.

These techniques optimize Claude's workflow, helping users avoid hitting usage limits while maintaining necessary context and accuracy. This approach balances token usage and computational depth, enhancing AI-assisted coding productivity. Advanced strategies like these reflect growing trends in AI prompt engineering for efficient programming.
